bends.note: angle point: north of here McMicken runs NNW to Marshall, south of here SSW

ends.note: south end: Cormany's lines stop at the Henry Adams Brewery yard (block 9); no street continues to Straight

notes: Names printed without a suffix (TAFEL, STRAIGHT, HALSTEAD, KLOTTMAN) are written with 'Street'; 'W. McMICKEN AV.' is 'West McMicken Avenue' as on 275. Scale here is about 6.2 px per foot (McMicken 60' = ~390 px). Marshall runs along the top edge: only its south line is drawn (y~253) and the paper begins at y~57, so the McMicken/Marshall point uses the south line plus half the printed 60' (centre y~70, just inside the paper; water-pipe junction at 3300,95 agrees). Marshall bends at McMicken: east of it the south line turns NE (3575,118)->(3715,55), i.e. Marshall heads NE across sheet 276. Marshall crosses the canal on an iron bridge (left of x~1500). Left edge x<~100 is the gutter/sheet 255 overlap: Cormany Avenue (from 255) and the 30' Heywood stub are visible there; Cormany/Heywood is picked on 255 and not repeated. Cormany runs SSE from its north end at the block 8 rear line (recorded on 255) and stops at the brewery yard (end recorded). Straight crosses the canal on a narrow 'WOOD BRIDGE' drawn diagonally (from ~830,3760 to ~1000,4070), both ends inside Straight's width, so Straight is treated as continuous at y~3910; Straight continues east off the right edge onto 257, as does Tafel (Tafel ends at McMicken on the west, T). Halstead (40') runs from Straight (T) south past both Klottman pieces off the bottom. Klottman is in two pieces 800 px apart: the 40' west piece from the canal (west end recorded on 255) to Halstead (T), and a 25' piece from Halstead (T) to McMicken (T), named 'Klottman Street (east of Halstead)'. An unnamed 10' alley runs from Straight south across the Klottman east piece to McMillan (widening to 15' at McMillan), recorded as two alley segments. West McMillan Street is along the bottom, but only its north line is on the paper (y~7665 at x 1050, 7635 at x 2390, 7700 east of McMicken); its centre (~7760-7780) is at or below the paper edge, so Halstead/McMillan, alley/McMillan and McMicken/McMillan are not recorded (they belong to 248). The y~2410-2650 strip south of Tafel east of McMicken is an undivided lot strip, not a street. Circled figures are grade elevations.
